svg.text: Parcel 377/1, Eregli Mah., Karamursel, Kocaeli -- Ground Floor (schematic example) -- SCHEMATIC, requires licensed-architect review before permitting or construction
Parcel 377/1 -- Eregli Mah., Karamursel, Kocaeli | Ada 377 / Parsel 1 (Tapu Kutugu: Eregli, Pafta G23d04d3d) | A-101: Ground Floor Plan (example) | 1:100 (schematic) | 2026-08-20

Lot: 36.02 m x 19.80 m (713.3 m2) -- Area 713.26 m2 CONFIRMED from imardurumu.pdf + minuspalityimardurumu.pdf (GIS/current figure; both flag 'Tapu alani esastir' -- deed area governs if it differs, not yet reconciled, no tapu provided). Width/depth split (36.02m x 19.80m) is a TEAM-DERIVED visual-proportion estimate read off the plotted parcel schema in both PDFs (quadrilateral, no jogs, wider than deep, single road frontage on Selcuk Bey Caddesi to the north) -- NOT a surveyed dimension; neither document has a legible printed edge-length on the parcel boundary. Needs an Arsa Aplikasyon Krokisi / Plankote for surveyed corner coordinates before this is anything more than a schematic placeholder shape.

Footprint: 127.1 m2 | TAKS used: 0.178 (limit 0.25) -- TAKS 0.25 / KAKS 1.00 / front 5m / side 3m CONFIRMED from imardurumu.pdf + minuspalityimardurumu.pdf (identical on both). Rear setback 3.00m via Planli Alanlar Imar Yonetmeligi Madde 23(1)(c) national fallback (plan notes item 4.2.10's h/2 formula does not apply -- scoped to mixed residential+commercial blocks, 377/1 is pure Konut Alani; plan notes item 1.1 directs the fallback). max_height=14.50m TEAM-DERIVED to eave level from plan notes item 4.2.4's residential floor-height defaults (4.00 + 3x3.50), since no Bina Yuksekligi meter figure is stated on either parcel document. Ground floor offset band [0.00, 1.00]m per plan notes item 4.2.22.
Red grade datum: 0.00 m | Ground floor: +0.15 m | Height: 4.15 m (limit 14.50 m)

SCHEMATIC DRAWING -- NOT FOR PERMIT OR CONSTRUCTION. Requires review, revision and stamp by a licensed architect before permitting or construction. Not a substitute for a structural/MEP engineer's calculations. No governmental review or approval implied or granted by this drawing.
